prior_failures.reason: Resolved Home URL changed after configuring the static front page; configuration intent fingerprint incorrectly included environment-resolved URLs.
prior_failures.fix: Hash portable configuration intent; then rerun the full suite successfully. Initial assertion counting also used a local eval-file variable and was corrected to shared test state.

prior_failures.operation: Actual 33-slot import attempted by parent agent
prior_failures.reason: WordPress refused the ICO favicon MIME type after 32 valid attachments had been uploaded and before Page creation.
prior_failures.fix: Validate the traced ICO as a theme runtime file without uploading or changing MIME policy; use the PNG site-icon attachment for native WordPress settings. A subsequent independent plan preserves all 32 attachments and safely proposes 11 drafts.
prior_failures.source: Parent operation report plus independently observed current stable markers/recovery plan; no successful retry is claimed here.

other_checks.php_lint: pass for all three PHP scripts
other_checks.scope: No theme runtime seeding or presentation plugin; crop-disabling filters exist only during importer uploads and are removed in finally.

cleanup: Allocated fixture page/attachment/menu IDs removed; one exact fixture option removed; complete prior configuration state, Reading/icon values and menu locations restored. Actual Page content and existing menu objects were not edited by this subagent.
limits: This is local PHP/WordPress/SQLite evidence, not IONOS/MySQL or browser/editor UI evidence.
Source hashes bind the actual tested files; this record does not claim a future commit or CI pass.
The exporter snapshot is private review data, not a public database backup or automatic overwrite input.

Actual full-site setup, editorial/candidate corrections and local publication are recorded separately by the parent agent; this suite alters only disposable fixture content and temporarily scoped settings, restoring the prior settings completely.

draft_link_regression.cause: WordPress get_permalink() uses query-ID links for drafts, even with pretty permalinks configured.
draft_link_regression.fix: Use the native get_page_link(id, false, true) sample Page API for intended draft slug URLs; intended static Home still maps to the root. Plain-permalink installations retain native plain URLs.
draft_link_regression.runtime_result: Fixture remains draft; its ordinary permalink reproduces query-ID behavior while the imported cross-page href contains its intended slug and no query-ID token.
draft_link_regression.actual_candidate_link_correction: Parent separately backed up and deliberately corrected the local candidate Home links.

post_cleanup_preservation_probe.note: Zero remaining old links follows the parent’s deliberate candidate correction; the fixture suite itself did not edit actual Page content.
